tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis mchod tshul gangs ljongs rjes brtse rab bskul bzhugs so// na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra badz+ra ku mā ra ya/ de la 'dir/ sdom gsum rab dbye las/ rgyal po khyod kyi bod yul 'dir/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis la gtad pas/ /mu stegs 'byung bar mi 'gyur mod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar gangs ri'i khrod 'dir/ bshad sgrub kyi sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin par 'dod pa rnams kyis/ bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi mchod gtor la brtson par bya'o/ /de yang 'di ltar/ sngon rje btsun sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying pos/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyis/ bstan ma bcu gnyis la mchod gtor mdzad pa mnal lam du gzigs pas 'thad dgongs nas thugs dam chag med mdzad gsungs pa'i zin bris kyi rjes su 'brang ste/ bstan ma bcu gnyis mchod pa'i tshul la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'dir gnas pa'i gangs ri dang mtsho 'gram sogs gnas gang rung du'am de ma yin pa'i ri rlung gtsang po'am/ yang na gnas khang gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i steng ngam nang du rten dang mchod pa ci 'byor dang / khyad par stegs bu gtsang mar ras sogs kyis bkab la 'bru bkram pa'i khar 'dir bdag mdun phur pa sa lugs kyi dbang du btang ste de'i dpal bshos g.yas su sman/ g.yon du rak+ta/ de'i mdun du bstan ma'i gtor ma lcags ri gru bzhi sgo gcig pa'i zur bzhir lcogs bzhi la shing gi yal ga dang / ku sha sogs gang 'byor la brten pa'i dar lcog dbus su khang pa gru bzhi pa bad bcas kyi steng g.yas su bdud bshos nag po gru gsum g.yas gcus bzhi sgrom/ de'i g.yon du sman btsun gyi zlum gtor dkar po bzhi sgrom/ de'i g.yon du sman btsun gyi zlum gtor dkar po bzhi sgrom/ de'i g.yon du gnod sbyin gyi dmar gtor gru gsum pa bzhi sgrom/

de'i g.yon du gnod sbyin gyi mar gtor gru gsum pa bzhi sgrom rnams la mar rgyan ci mdzes dang / gtor dar so so'i sku mdog can mda' sogs la brten pa ma 'byor na so so'i tsakli/ de'i g.yas su sman phud/ g.yon du rak+ta rgya phor dang dngul phor la sogs par phye mar phud skyems 'bru dang gser g.yu bran pa dkar skyems 'o mar sman sna btab pa/ mngar skyems sbrang chang ngam bu ram chur sbyar ba bcas pa rnams dang / nyer spyod rnam lnga dang / sman shing spos dkar sogs kyi dud sprin mda' dar sogs spyan gzigs sna tshogs dang / nyer mkho'i yo byad rnams tshogs par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dpal sa skya'i rgyun gyi phyag len ltar rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa bsnyen sgrub gsal byed nas 'byung ba bzhin mchod pa byin rlabs nas bzlas pa bsdu ba'i bar byas la tshogs yod na phur pa'i tshogs mchod bsdus pa bzhin byin brlabs nas/ bsgral mchod kyi bar/ de nas bstan ma'i gtor ma phur pa'i gtor ma ltar byin brlabs la/ yo byad gzhan rnams sngags drug phyag drug bsangs sogs nas 'byung ba bzhin gyis byin brlabs te/ lag pa gnyis g.yas steng du bzhag nas rgyab sbyar te bsnol ba'i mthe'u chung sbrel/ mthe bong lag mthil so sor bkug pa zil gnon khyung gshog gis phyag rgya bcas la/ hoḥ bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis/ dpal chen po'i pha 'bags la nos te/ rnal 'byor pa'i sdong dang grogs la/ nag mo bzhin mi sdug pa'i bu mo bdud mo chen mo bzhi ni/ rngams shing khros pa'i cha byad can/ dmar mo khro gnyer can gyi bu mo gnod sbyin mo chen mo bzhi ni/ bzhin ni mi sdug gnod sbyin gyi cha byad can dkar sham mgrin bzang ma'i bu mo/ sman btsun ma chen mo bzhi ni/ na chung ma chen mo mdzes ma'i cha byad can 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ sngon gyi thugs dam las ma 'da' bar 'dir gshegs shig

ḍā ki ni hūm̐ dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ e a ra li hriṃ hriṃ bh+yoḥ bka' yi bran g.yog tshogs dang bcas nyid du/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung de bzhin nam mkha'i sku/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bstan ma skyong ba rnams/ /sngon gyi thugs dam dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /'dir gshegs dam dgongs mchod sbyin gtor ma bzhes/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /bsam yas dbus kyi sgrags yul phu nang nas/ /bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma/ /sku mdog sngon po chibs su shwa pho chibs/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pa khram shing bsnams/ /lho bod mtshams kyi gangs ri chen po nas/ /dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong / /sku mdog ser mo chibs su rta la chibs/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas zhags pa bsnams/ /gnya' nang brin gyi phu nas spyan 'dren gyi/ /gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje kun tu bzang / /sku mdog dmar mo chibs su bong bu chibs/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas bhan+dha bsnams/ /gtsang po'i rgyab phyogs 'brog gnas do nag na/ /'brog chen 'khor 'dul rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso/ /sku mdog ljang nag chibs su rnga mo chibs/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas dbyug tho bsnams/ /bdud kyi bu mo chen mo khyed bzhi yang / /sngon gyi thugs dam dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /bran dang g.yog 'khor mang po'i tshogs dang bcas/ /lhab lhub rin chen mang po'i rgyan dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs dam dgongs mchod sbyin gtor ma bzhes/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /'u yug phu yi shar phyogs gangs rtse nas/ /gangs dkar sha med rdo rje g.yu bun ma/ /sku mdog dkar mo stag mo grus mar chibs/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas ral gri bsnams/ /bar thang shar gyi ri phug thod na gnas/ /kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum/ /sku mdog ser mo chibs su kam kar chibs/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas satwa gri bsnams/

/nags rgya bo dong phu yi phyogs shig na/ /gser chen mkha' rgyu rdo rje rlung mo rgyal/ /sku mdog dmar mo chibs su dom nag chibs/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas lcags kyu bsnams/ /mdo khams rma chen spom ra'i rtse zhig nas/ /rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal/ /sku mdog ljang khu gdug pa'i dred la chibs/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas mi snying bsnams/ /gnod sbyin bu mo chen mo khyed bzhi yang / /sngon gyi thugs dam gnyan༞ /bran dang༞ /lhab lhub༞ /'dir gshegs༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /grong yul bre nang mthil gyi phyogs shed na/ /kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyongs/ /sku mdog dkar mo chibs su shwa ba chibs/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas gser zhags bsnams/ /sman gcig phur thang bsam lding rgyab ri nas/ /btsan la rol pa'i rdo rje sman gcig ma/ /sku mdog ser mo chibs su btsod la chibs/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas dril bu bsnams/ /mdo khams smad kyi g.yar mo thang shod na/ /sman btsun ug chos rdo rje g.yar mo bsil/ /sku mdog dmar mo chibs su 'bri la chibs/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas tshon gru bsnams/ /la stod lho yi shel phug phyogs shed na/ /g.yu yi dril bu rdo rje gzugs legs ma/ /sku mdog mthing nag chibs su rkyang la chibs/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas lcags kyu bsnams/ /sman btsun bu mo chen mo khyed bzhi yang / /sngon gyi thugs dam༞ /bran dang༞ /lhab lhub༞ /'dir gshegs༞ /rnal 'byor༞ /mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ lan sum cu so drug gis bsngo ba ste/ gtor ma re re gsum gsum gyis bsngo ba'i lugs so/ /thal mo sbyar la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs dam pa༞ de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas la༞

de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba'i dpal la༞ na mo bdag gis bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs par/ /thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /bdud mo bzhi/ gnod sbyin mo bzhi/ sman mo bzhi ste bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa pha ma sems can thams cad bde zhing skyid pa/ bdag cag rnal 'byor pa 'khor bcas kyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba/ thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal tu gsol/ de nas bstod pa dang gsol ba gdab pa ni/ sgrags kyi yongs rdzogs zhes bya'i gnas mchog nas/ /bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma/ /sku mdog sngon po bdud rta nag po zhon/ /lus la mi lpags gyon shing khram nag 'phyar/ /lho bal zhes bya'i mtshams kyi gnas mchog nas/ /dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong / /sku mdog dkar mo seng ge dkar mor chibs/ /dar dkar gsol zhing gser gyi rdo rje bsnams/ /'brog gi do nag ces bya'i gnas mchog na/ /'brog chen 'khor 'dul rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso/ /sku mdog ser mo sa le 'bri la zhon/ /ro thul gsol zhing dung gi tshugs shing bsnams/ /brin zhes bya ba'i gangs kyi gnas mchog na/ /gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje kun bzang mo/ /sku mdog dkar mo btsod pho ru ring zhon/ /ras gos gsol zhing gser gyi phyag shing bsnams/ /jo mo gangs zhes bya ba'i gnas mchog na/ /gangs dkar sha med rdo rje spyan gcig ma/ /sku mdog dkar mo gnyan mdzo dkar por zhon/ /btsod kyi pags gyon g.yu 'brug zhags pa bsnams/ /bo dong nags rgyal zhes bya'i gnas mchog na/ /gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje rlung mo ni/ /sku mdog ser mo rkyang bu kha dkar zhon/

/sram thul gsol zhing phyag na gser mda' bsnams/ /rma chen spom ra zhes bya'i gnas mchog na/ /rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal/ /sku mdog dmar mo gnyan mo ru gtum zhon/ /chu srin g.yang gzhi gsol zhing sbal pa bsnams/ /kha rag brag ces bya ba'i gnas mchog na/ /kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum/ /sku mdog dmar mo bong bu rog po zhon/ /dar nag gsol zhing bdud kyi khram shing bsnams/ /kong po mthil zhes bya ba'i gnas mchog na/ /kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong / /sku mdog smug mo dre'u chibs su chibs/ /dar nag gsol zhing nad kyi rkyal pa bsnams/ /sman gcig phur thang zhes bya'i gnas mchog na/ /btsan la ro gsol rdo rje sman gcig ma/ /sku mdog ser mo shwa ba chibs su zhon/ /gangs ral gyon cing li ru dmar po bsnams/ /g.yar mo thang zhes bya'i gnas mchog na/ /mo btsun ug chos rdo rje g.yar mo bsil/ /sku mdog dmar skya rnga mo gwa par chibs/ gangs stod gsol zhing ne'u le'i rkyal pa 'dzin/ /bud ring shos bu'i ri rtsi'i gnas mchog na/ /g.yu yi dril snyan rdo rje gzugs legs ma/ /sku mdog ljang gu btsod pho ru ring zhon/ /dar dkar gsol zhing rin chen sgrom bu bsnams/ /che zhes chen mo khyed rnams kyang / /rdo rje thod phreng spyan snga ru/ /zhing chen tshogs kyi mchod bkram nas/ /rnam lnga bdud rtsi'i longs spyod kyis/ /dbang bskur ming btags dam nos te/ /thar pa thob pa'i ming btags nas/ /lag tu rdo rje byin nas ni/ /rdo rje 'chang gi gral du bzhag /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i grogs byos shig /dgra bgegs thams cad 'dul ba dang / /nad rnams thams cad bzlog pa dang / /bsam pa thams cad bsgrub bya'i phyir/ /bka' yi gtor ma 'di long la/ /bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /dam tshig 'di las ma 'da' zhig /dam tshig 'di las 'das gyur na/

/rdo rje yak+ṣa khros pa yis/ /snying gi dkyil nas khrag drangs nas/ /'o dod 'bod par gdon mi za/ /de bas bdag gis bcol ba yi/ /phrin las thams cad 'grub par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing sogs sh+lau ka gcig la kun 'grub mdzod/ ces dang / stobs ldan rnams kyi rgyud la bsam ngan gyi/ /'jig rten phung sems zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /ci ste las ngan dbang gis phung g.yos kyang / /nus med rang zhir 'gyur ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /gzhan dma' 'bebs phyir g.yo rgyu khram gsum gyi/ /'khrug longs ma lus zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /chags sdang dbang gi dus 'khrug 'di zhi nas/ /so so rang dbang thob pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad dang rims kun dang / /bgegs rigs brgyad khri gdon chen bco lnga sogs/ /lus srog dge la bar du gcod pa yi/ /'byung po'i gnod pa zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /skar mda' ltung dang sa g.yos 'jigs pa dang / /byad stims mthu dang thog ser 'bebs pa sogs/ /mi dang mi ma yin gyi gnod pa dang / /nyer 'tshe mtha' dag zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /glo bur ye 'drog gnod pa ma lus dang / /dug dang sbyar dug kha zas ma zhu dang / /'khon dang nyams grib 'bags dang mi gtsang sogs/ /dri ma thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /dus min 'chi bar gyur pa sna tshogs dang / /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan pa dang / /'jigs pa brgyad sogs nye bar 'tshe ba rnams/ /myur du zhi zhing med pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /yul phyogs kun tu char chu dus su 'bab/ /lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /mi nad phyugs nad dus 'khrug rgyun chad nas/ /rgyal khams bde bas 'tsho ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /rgyal bstan dar zhing bstan 'dzin bshad sgrub 'phel/ /rgyal pos chos spyod 'gro rnams dge bcur ldan/ /nad mug 'khrug rtsod ming yang mi grags cing / /rdzogs ldan bde skyid dar ba'i dngos grub stsol/༈ 'di bzhin yang na phrin las mdzod yang na bkra shis sogs tshigs bsgyur gang shes bya chog

ya hi gats+tsha/ ces brjod la gtor ma phul/ gsum pa ni/ ye shes lnga ldan sogs kyi dngos grub blangs/ bzod gsol brtan bzhugs bshags tshul 'di yang / kun mkhyen dga' sdong pa chos rgyal dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i bstan skyong ma skabs su babs pa'i gong 'og tu bsgrigs te/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bod khams bde ba'i phyir lhag bsam rnam par dag pas sbyar/ 'di rang re'i phyag len ltar gtong tshul ni/ phur chung la byin dbab bsdus pa'i bsdus pa sngon 'gro'i rnga brdung gi gtong lugs sgrub mchod kyi sa chog skabs mdzad pa ltar dang / bh+yoḥ bka' yi bran g.yog sogs la bcom rol la 'phar yod med gang rung dang bzhi brdung sogs rol mo dang dbyangs phyag len bzhin/ sman btsun ma'i mtha'i rnal 'byor pa bcol pa'i phrin las sogs la tshig rol byas la rnga rol bzhag gtor ma bsngo ba nas stsal du gsol bar brjod/ bcom rol nyis brdeg len can dgra bgegs kyi yongs rdzogs sh+lau ka gcig la/ bh+yoḥ wā ya sogs thams cad dbang sdud pa'i dbyangs rol dam tshig 'di las la mtshams dbyangs rol mo bcas la chem brdungs med pa/ 'jig rten bde zhing nas rdzogs ldan bde skyid dar ba la tshig rol gyi mthar chem brdungs gsum brdeg len can dngos grub blangs pa ni nges par dgos/ yig brgya dang bzod gsol byas kyang 'gal ba med/ brtan bzhugs dang bshags gsol nas rten yod pa dang dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan drangs pa ltar na dgos/ de man mi dgos/ bstan skyong gi mthar/ ya hi gats+tsha/ zhes 'byung bas bstan ma la bshags gsol zur du mi dgos/ go bgo ba man chad bya zhing / gtor bsngo bskang ba gzhan dang sbrel na bstan skyong gtong mtshams phyag len bzhin/ rgya gar shes bsangs dang sbrel na mchod gtor byin brlabs ni gong gi sngags drug phyag drug dang / bdag bskyed ni drin yod pas zur du mi dgos shing /

grul bum dri za sa bdag bsangs/ kyai bsangs so/ /zhes pa'i rjes su/ hoḥ bod khams skyong ba'i nas/ dngos grub stsol bar gong bzhin gyi mthar rol mo khad kyis len pa sogs bsangs bzhin dang / kyai bsangs so/ /zhes sbyar/ ya hi gats+tsha mi dgos/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dpal chen he ru ka nyid dang / /zhes sogs bsangs kyi 'phro 'thud pas don tshang zhing / bshags gsol ni/ bsangs gzhung 'dir ma bshad pas mgron rnams mi dmigs pa'i ngang la gzhag pa'i go don no// //bkra shis// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 kun dga' blo gros/ bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis mchod tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
